title: Going Berserker mode (Berserk physique introduction)
summary: Introduces the 'Berserker physique', NH's ideal look: massive arms and legs out of proportion with a smaller trunk, big upper back, traps, neck, forearms and calves, an X-taper rather than a V-taper, and visible vascularity at about 14-18% bodyfat. Inspired by Nordic berserkers and characters such as Zodd (Berserk) and Gon and Biscuit (Hunter x Hunter). Announces a Berserker series by body part.

claims.claim: YouTubers name their ideal physiques, e.g. Alpha Destiny's 'bear mode': mass on shoulders, traps and upper back, big forearms and long-head triceps, posterior-chain focus, higher bodyfat.

Berserkers in Norse myth entered a fighting trance with immense strength and then crashed into depression, a price paid like Guts with the Berserker Armor; he likes the mythical figure, not the strength aspect.

His ideal Berserker physique: massive arms and legs that look out of proportion with a trunk (chest, abs, core) that's not small but comparatively smaller, smaller shoulders, very developed upper back.
The Berserker physique is stocky with an X-taper rather than a V-taper, plus big calves, forearms, traps and neck.
Ideal Berserker bodyfat is not shredded but lean enough for vascularity, especially veins popping in upper arms and forearms: roughly 14-18%.
Characters with the Berserker physique: Gon (transformed) and Biscuit from Hunter x Hunter and Zodd from Berserk; Guts himself has more of a V-taper.
The channel will also cover fictional fitness, including videos on characters like Guts.
He doesn't care about having a tiny waist and can't anyway; his training, methodology and mentality aim at massive arms, massive legs and a strong core.
